questions.text: What should people learn from the agenda before a meeting?

options.text: The topics, goals and time for each item
Everything the organiser knows about each topic

questions.explanation: People can prepare when they know the topics, goals and time for each item.

questions.text: One person does most of the talking. What should you do as the facilitator?

options.text: Pause and invite others to speak
Let them speak until the meeting ends
Ask the note taker to decide for everyone

questions.explanation: Invite others to speak so everyone can contribute.

questions.text: What should you confirm before the meeting ends?

options.text: That everyone spoke for the same amount of time
The decisions, who will do each task and by when
That another meeting is already booked

questions.explanation: Confirm what was decided, who will do each task and by when.
